notes.title: Beta 0.3.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a few invisible colliders so NPCs can't go places they shouldn't (hornbeast in the pond, purple baylos falling off the clouds)

[*] Added a volume slider for background music to the pause menu

[*] Adjusted background initialization so the proper background loads when continuing a saved game from any location

[*] Fixed music fading glitch when rapidly switching between zones

[*] Adjusted a few note sequences for some puzzles

[*] Fixed issue with player inertia causing strange interactions with objects in the world (should no longer be able to push the Blue Devil or other objects into walls and floors)

[*] Added names of new testers and supporters to the credits
[/list]
